# London Robotic Surgeon

> Official website of Prof. Hemant Sheth, Consultant Upper GI, Laparoscopic and Robotic Surgeon serving London and Hertfordshire.

## Canonical website

- https://londonroboticsurgeon.co.uk/

## Main pages

- Professional profile and institutional evidence: https://londonroboticsurgeon.co.uk/about-prof-hemant-sheth
- Treatment directory and patient guides: https://londonroboticsurgeon.co.uk/treatments
- Robotic surgery explanations, direct answers and NHS evidence: https://londonroboticsurgeon.co.uk/robotic-surgery
- Verified public consultation locations: https://londonroboticsurgeon.co.uk/locations

## Specialties

- Upper GI, laparoscopic and hepatobiliary (HPB) surgery
- Gallbladder and gallstone surgery (laparoscopic cholecystectomy)
- Reflux, GORD and hiatus hernia surgery (laparoscopic fundoplication)
- Hernia repair (laparoscopic TEP/TAPP, diaphragmatic, complex incisional)
- Liver and biliary conditions (benign liver disease, bile duct exploration, splenectomy)
- Upper GI endoscopy and gastroscopy
- Laparoscopic appendicectomy
- Robotic-assisted surgery, within the Ealing Hospital NHS robotic programme (gallbladder, hernia and anti-reflux procedures)

## Primary institutional evidence

- London North West University Healthcare NHS Trust, 29 May 2026: https://www.lnwh.nhs.uk/news/surgeon-embraces-robotic-surgery-12793
- London North West University Healthcare NHS Trust, 8 June 2026: https://www.lnwh.nhs.uk/news/ealing-robot-wins-hearts-and-minds-12842
- London North West University Healthcare NHS Trust, 28 July 2026: https://www.lnwh.nhs.uk/news/robot-celebrates-100th-procedure-13015
- Royal College of Surgeons of England surgical tutor directory: https://www.rcseng.ac.uk/careers-in-surgery/outreach/contact-your-surgical-tutor/

## Evidence boundaries

- Dated procedure figures describe the early Ealing Hospital robotic programme and are not current personal totals.
- The site does not claim that robotic surgery is automatically better than laparoscopic or open surgery.
- Suitability for any surgical approach requires individual clinical assessment.
- Only clinic locations approved for public display are included in the location directory.

## Patient information

The medical information on this website is educational and does not replace an individual medical consultation. Clinic details and appointment availability should be confirmed directly when booking.
